evidence: The mounted app.biocatalyst router still exposes exactly the ten declared /api/biocatalyst/v1 paths; the fixture route list is unchanged.
All eight declared output_contracts resolve inside ContractRegistry, so the adapter remains an executable versioned contract.
point_in_time_scope stays committed_current_public_generation: current-record facts only, no issuer or security identity.
read_earnings_transcript_context_bundle is still declared in the adapter module and the module still declares no APIRouter and no @router decorator.
biocatalyst_transcript_context_bundle.v1 remains a registered contract; the transcript-only limitation list is unchanged.
Scope stays private in-process transcript context with no issuer, security, sponsor, or trial linkage.
read_company_intelligence accepts only ticker, limit, and event_id: there is no as_of or knowledge-time parameter, so the reader cannot answer a point-in-time question.
company_intelligence_context.v1 is not a registered ContractRegistry contract id, so the declared output has no executable versioned schema BioCatalyst can validate against.
The reader is documented as ticker-keyed context only, explicitly not identity or asset ownership; a private-company identity remains out of reach.
The registration generic_company_identity still carries writer null and implementation_state partial_ticker_context_reader_not_pit_identity.
collectors.symbol_directory still exposes only SymbolDirectoryAdapter over Nasdaq and SEC roster files; it declares no BioCatalyst-facing read callable.
symbol_directory_snapshot.v1 is not a registered ContractRegistry contract id, so the snapshot has no executable versioned schema.
The registration keeps its four limitations including incomplete_corporate_action_history and no_global_security_master, so corporate actions are not point-in-time resolvable.
sec_document_spine declares fundamental_forensics.sec_filing_manifest/v1 and fundamental_forensics.sec_archive_receipt/v1, neither of which is a registered ContractRegistry contract id.
The module exposes archive_index_document and build_filing_manifests as owner-internal substrate helpers; there is no cross-domain span read callable for BioCatalyst.
The registration still has writer null and implementation_state owner_substrates_exist_no_biocatalyst_read_contract.

None of the five capital-structure routes accepts an as_of parameter; the only as_of in app/capital_structure.py is the single current bundle stamp, so the plane serves a current projection twin and not a point-in-time read.
capital_structure.projection_bundle.v1 is not a registered ContractRegistry contract id, so BioCatalyst has no schema it can validate a borrowed bundle against.
UNAVAILABLE_CAPABILITIES still lists cash_runway, fully_diluted_shares, instruments, and financing_probability, so the unavailable-state semantics BioCatalyst needs are not expressed as a contract.

User state stays an active_external_plane owned by terminal_supabase with no BioCatalyst read-adapter slot; this audit did not open one.
Its prohibited_biocatalyst_fallbacks still forbid a local user database and browser-owned canonical state.
Neural Web remains interface_only with domain_truth_writes, source_record_mutation, and prediction_origination prohibited; no BioCatalyst read-adapter slot exists or was added.
